items.title: Wendy Oxenhorn — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think our social worker, Lisa, made this connection with Beethoven Pianos

ctx.x: Oh, that’s a great story. I think our social worker, Lisa, made this connection with Beethoven Pianos, and they shipped 18 pianos. We had two drivers drive them down to the musicians, and Fats was one of them. When he got his piano, they didn’t even get it into the driveway, and he ran out and he started playing “Blueberry Hill” for the drivers.
There’s a photograph on your website of him playing for the truck drivers.
